# Patryk Chojecki

> Personal website for Patryk Chojecki, an early-stage startup investor at 886 Studios interested in ambitious founders building with AI, wherever they’re from.

Use this file as a concise routing guide to the public pages on chojecki.net. Prefer the linked source pages for exact wording, dates, and citations.

Best short summary: Patryk Chojecki is an early-stage startup investor at 886 Studios, interested in ambitious founders from any country building with AI. Originally from Poland and based in Taipei, he supports founders on fundraising, product development, investor relations, and market entry.

## Key Facts

- Current role: Program Manager at 886 Studios in Taipei.
- Investment interests: Early-stage startups and ambitious founders building with AI, wherever they’re from.
- Current work: ikigai Launchpad, investment sourcing, startup accelerator operations, founder support, fundraising readiness, investor and mentor workflows, market entry, and startup reporting.
- Previous venture experience: Associate at CellTech Accelerator from 2023 to early 2026, focused on biotech and life-science startups.
- Location: Taipei, Taiwan.
- Background: Originally from Poland; educated at Jagiellonian University and National Chengchi University.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://chojecki.net/projects/): Apps, tools, and websites built by Patryk Chojecki.
- [CherryTerminal](https://chojecki.net/projects/#cherry-terminal): A private portfolio tracker for holdings, cash, watchlists, and a clearer view of what you own.
- [CherryCash](https://chojecki.net/projects/#cherry-cash): An iPhone app for sharing everyday expenses and trip costs with your partner.
- [Personal Website](https://chojecki.net/projects/#personal-website): My home on the web for writing, projects, and life in Taipei.
- [886 Studios Website](https://chojecki.net/projects/#886-studios-redesign): The home of 886 Studios, its startup programs, portfolio, events, and founder resources.
- [ikigai Startup Portal](https://chojecki.net/projects/#ikigai-startup-portal): A private workspace for 886 Studios founders to share progress and track startup metrics.
- [CmdZ](https://chojecki.net/projects/#cmdz): A small browser extension that reopens closed tabs with Command+Z or Ctrl+Z while keeping Undo intact.
